title: Inspect and extend: Decide whether text is a web address or a search
objective: Use the real implementation in `Sources/Core.swift` to demonstrate and safely improve input classification, scheme handling, empty input, and search-engine selection.
problem: A browser address box has two jobs: open a likely URL or search ordinary words. Read the core decision function and tests for empty text, scheme insertion, and selected engine behavior. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `Sources/Core.swift` and the related project files: Sources/Core.swift; Tests/BrowserCoreTests.swift.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to input classification, scheme handling, empty input, and search-engine selection.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: The engine routing is a sample rule; it does not implement DuckDuckGo product services.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: A browser address box has two jobs: open a likely URL or search ordinary words. Read the core decision function and tests for empty text, scheme insertion, and selected engine behavior.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `Sources/Core.swift`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
